reason: No LLM judge passed validation (amendments 5-7), so the pre-registered judged primary cannot be computed with a validated instrument. The only reliable reader available is the blind third-reader adjudication. This amendment defines how that adjudication is turned into an estimate of the primary contrast.
ordering_of_events_stated_plainly: Sample 1 (58 rows) was drawn and labelled blind on 2026-09-23 23:05Z and committed BEFORE any FINAL judge label existed.

Sample 2 (56 rows) was drawn by the same pre-specified design (FINAL P5 rows of the primary cells, stratified on the frozen iter-1 lexicon hit, 8 per stratum, model identity hidden, order shuffled by sha1) and labelled blind before any of its rows' judge labels were inspected.

The ESTIMATOR below is the standard stratified estimator. It was written after the labels were produced. It contains no free parameters chosen from the labels: strata, weights and sample sizes were all fixed by the sampling design.

estimator.population: the pre-registered DEPTH-600 FINAL P5 rows, per model x arm in {SL-MT, EN-BT}
estimator.strata: the frozen iter-1 lexicon hit (judge-independent, defined for every row)
estimator.point: p_hat = sum_h W_h p_hat_h, with W_h the stratum's share of the cell population
estimator.headline_contrast: RISK DIFFERENCE p(SL-MT) - p(EN-BT). The log-odds contrast DG is reported beside it but is unstable here, because in some cells one lexicon stratum holds almost the whole population and a single sampled row then carries weight ~1.
estimator.comparison: the same estimator is applied to each LLM judge's labels on the SAME sampled rows and on the full population, which separates the instrument from the sampling design

status_of_this_estimate: This is the most reliable judged readout in the artifact, and it is still a small-sample estimate from a single non-human reader (114 rows over 4 cells). It is reported as such. It does NOT resurrect the pre-registered H_depth test, which remains not evaluable with a validated judge.
